Get The iPhone 17 With Monthly Plans And Upgrade For Free: 5 Things You Should Know
Curated By :
Last Updated:
Buying iPhone 17 can be expensive for many people, even on EMIs but this new model offers you the chance to own one and upgrade.
Apple launched the iPhone 17 series last month, and many people have bought the new shiny model. But there are still many out there who aspire to own the latest iPhone 17 or 17 Pro version but are not willing to spend big. For these people there is a new way to own the iPhone and it is called subscription.
1/5
With BytePe, you can get iPhone 17 for as low as Rs 3,799 per month or over Rs 7,200 per month for Samsung’s Galaxy Z Fold 7 model. These would usually cost you well over Rs 75,000 and Rs 1,70,000 in the market.
2/5
You go to the website, select the phone you want to subscribe to, choose the payment plan which fits your needs and budget and pay the monthly amount. You also get the option to upgrade at the end of the plan or continue using it further.
ADVERTISEMENT
3/5
BytePe says anybody can upgrade their model (let’s say, iPhone 17 to iPhone 18), as long as the phone turns on, and you can use the screen to navigate to the home screen. You should also sign out of all the accounts and factory reset the device to be returned.
4/5
BytePe is offering a one-time free damage protection benefit with any device that you subscribe to, but any more damages will have to be repaired through a company service centre.
